description: Rules for writing an HTML page that works as a Hushdrop link and reads as finished client work: single file, no outside requests, phone-first, light/dark, print, where forms post. Read this before generating a page you will publish. When publishing into a team, pass team to also get that team's house style (follow it where it differs from the general rules).

team.description: Team handle you're about to publish into; adds the team's house style to the rules.

name: page_rules
title: Read the page-writing rules
